opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

deadlines.raw: 1st day of February, April, June, August, October and December

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scheme A open to undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva; Schemes B & C open to PhD students and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva; UK‑based members for non‑UK conferences; one grant per two years for Schemes B/C.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance at Genetics Society meetings, Special Interest Group meetings, non‑Society conferences and virtual conferences for junior scientists.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK; students need to be members; others need at least one year of membership.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to enable members to attend short training courses or collaborative visits to other laboratories for genetics/genomics techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK (or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK); members must have at least one year of membership; students need a supporting letter from a supervisor who is also a member.
opportunities.summary: Awards up to £2,000 to cover travel, accommodation and consumables for field‑based genetic research projects suitable for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities related to genetics, covering eligible travel and material costs, up to £1,000 per project.
